name: Spoon
description: The household shopping list and recipe book.
_comment_colours: The manifest spec has no media queries, so these two cannot follow the theme. They are read at install time and only drive the splash and the very first frame; the live bars come from the paired theme-color metas in index.html, which do follow it. Dark Cobalt is the constant because both phones run dark - a dark splash under a light app beats a white flash under a dark one.
